column2: You have been defeated Comrade General.  The Party is most displeased with your performance.  Due to your failure, at Prohkorovka, many workers and peasants are no longer with us.  Report immediately for punishment, you will be informed of your trial date later.

At this moment, the fascist invaders are in retreat.  But, we know they hope to stop our offensive along the Dnepr River.  You and your men will force a crossing of the river aided by our Guards Airborne forces. The sight of red parachutes will help demoralize the fascists and bring us victory.
Thanks are in order to you and your devoted troops, you are true Communists.  The enemy is fleeing before us. And now, our army has successfully crossed the Dnepr.  Good work, Comrade General.
General that wasn't what I had hoped for.
Ivan's supply lines are still intact and the British are holding on by their
fingernails.
We don't have much choice but to try again.

Your failure to follow the advice of your political advisors has cost the party dearly.  Only by bringing in reinforcements could the crossing of the Dnepr be forced.  It is clear the party must place a more dedicated communist in command.  Report to Stalingrad immediately to assist in rebuilding that city.

Comrade General, for over 900 days, Leningrad has been entrapped by the fascist invaders.  The Party has decreed that you must break their stranglehold on the city.  Comrade, the people must be freed at all costs. Their sacrifices must not have been in vain.

Superb performance, Comrade General.  I salute you.  You and your troops have successfully freed Leningrad.  The birthplace of the revolution can again breathe the sweet air of freedom.  Now, we must help our Finnish brothers to the north to escape the fascist scourge.

Very good, very good!  You and your troops have successfully freed Leningrad.  The birthplace of the revolution can again breathe the sweet air of freedom.  Now, we must help our Finnish brothers to the north to escape the fascist scourge.
You've driven deep into Ivan's flank and severely restricted his supplies to
the front.
This should help the British a great deal but we need to do more.

It is time to help the oppressed people of Finland break their capitalist chains, Comrade General.  You and your troops must capture the city of Vyborg, or "Viipuri" as it is known in their language.  The Finns foolishly believe that Vyborg is an ancient Finnish city.  Typical capitalist lie.  But, to defend their city, they will use all available reserves, including their contemptible navy and air force.  Good luck, Comrade.

Comrade General.  Please, come in. Some caviar?  The occupation of Vyborg has broken the will of the fascists.  The Finns have been abandoned by their German allies and have sued for peace.  Finally, a proper socialist government has been installed.  Excellent, excellent work.

Comrade General.  Please, come in.  The occupation of Vyborg has broken the will of the fascists.  The Finns have been abandoned by their German allies and have sued for peace.  Finally, a proper socialist government has been installed. Good work.

Thanks to your feeble efforts, the war in the Med will continue to drag on.  You will return immediately to England to face a court martial. Your replacement here will be General Montgomery.  You are dismissed.

Well, Comrade General, thanks to your abject failure, the Finns continue to defy us and capitalist rule is still in place.  The Party is most displeased with your inept performance.  You are relieved of your command.

The historical dialectic has once again proven its inevitable truth.  We stand at the gates of the fascist capital.  It is your task, Comrade General, to destroy this nest of vipers so that the Soviet peoples' sacrifices will not have been pointless.  Once the enemy along the Seelow Heights have been eradicated, the road to the fascist capital will be open.  Good luck, Comrade.

The Party has brought the Great Patriotic War to a victorious end and we celebrate your role in this final battle.  The banners of the SSSR fly over the Reichstag, and our liberation mission is complete.  All the peoples of the world herald your name for freeing them from the fascist nightmare. Comrade General, a dacha on the Black Sea has been granted you and awaits your pleasure. And now, Vodka!

Comrade General, we congratulate you!  You are a true Hero of the Soviet Union.  Your forces have freed the world from the scourge of fascism, and the people of the world celebrate this victory with you.  The party, in order to show its gratitude, has secured for you an apartment in Moskva, and looks forward to your continued loyal service.  And now, let us drink tea.  The samovar is full!

Comrade General, you have completed your mission.  The fascists have been crushed. The western capitalists now understand that a state of free workers and peasants under the enlightened guidance of the Party can never be defeated.  You will be granted a medal to be worn proudly as evidence of your sacrifice and heroism.  Congratulations.

You were given the chance to end this war with a glorious victory.  Instead, you dithered on the approaches to the fascist capital, and have allowed the sacrifices of your brave troops to go to waste.  It is fortunate for you, Comrade General, that we have won the war. You will report immediately to a site in the Urals to engage in self-criticism.
Good job, you really pasted those Reds!. Now it's time for us to go over to the attack again. Get your men ready Commander.
Note: PG2 scenario converted for PeG-WW2 by Robert Mary, use USA 46 or USSR 46 gameset depending on the chosen side.

Unfortunately, sir, you have not quite met the expectations of crown and government.  You will be transferred to, what shall we say, a less exciting post.  I believe there is a billet awaiting you in Nepal, training our Gurkha volunteers. I would arrange to obtain warm clothing. You will need it.
The German plan for the 1940 campaign in the west centered around a
surprise strike through the dense Ardennes forest, emerging at Sedan to
drive across France to the English Channel. This portion of the French
line was considered the safest outside of Maginot, shielded as it was by
the heavily forested Ardennes.
Despite the stunning German success, many things could have gone
wrong.   The French might have succeeded and the German advance to
the sea slowed enough to allow the Allied mobile forces to escape from
the encirclement at Dunkirk.
The Allies, after securing a beachhead in Italy, try to push the Germans
away from Salerno and drive northward towards Naples.

The Allies, after securing a beachhead in Italy, try to push the Germans away from Salerno and drive northward towards Naples.

Congratulations, with your leadership, our troops have erased all British presence here!. The other side of the river is secured, and now we can continue with our journey to Bristol. Good Work again, General.
Soviet resistance to the US counterattack stiffens.
BLITZKRIEG with Germany's SS PanzerDivisions
PG2 Campaign Designer: John McNulty, 21/10/1998
You take command of Elite German SS PanzerDivisions from the civil
war in Spain, to the blitzkrieg victories of early World War II, and then to
the tough battles with the Allies later in the war.
This is a very tough and lengthy campaign!

Your lack of leadership under fire is simply not acceptable - we expected much more of you. I believe the stress is getting to you after all these years so I have recommended that you be sent home on an extended leave.
You defended the empire during dark times and for that we are grateful. Good luck for the future.
General, no time for chit chat, weve got Ivan on the run.
Don't slow down and let him stabilize his front.
Keep pushing West.
You've chosen the path of Dover - Margate, good luck!!
This is Impossible, you haven't chosen any path, please, repeat the operation to choose any path.
You've chosen the path to Lyme Regis, good luck!!!
You've chosen the path to Brighton - Portsmouth, good luck !!!
General, the fighting was hard, but London is ours, Churchill has escaped to the north, now no one can deny the victory of the Third Reich!!
Congratulations!!
That was crap.
Your job was to prevent Ivan from pulling his forces back along the
railroad.  You failed.
Don't let me down again general
The Soviets are disrupted and the Brits have stabilized their
sector.

Commander, it may have been to your advantage to have remained in captivity. This failure was completely unexpected from an officer of your caliber and experience. Your transfer to mine removal duty will be forthcoming.
Very Good!, your performance was really good, you will recieve much prestige to buy transports.
We strongly recomend you don't spend your credits in other things.
The first stage of our operations is over, we've secured the coasts and now is our turn to go inside the island.
Very Good General! you have accomplished the objectives on time.
With this victory, the 16th army being under your command, and the supporting 9th army, you will take separate ways. You to the north and the 9th to the west.
General, maybe we've underestimated the Brits, but the troops in these sector have been lower than we had expected, Congratulations anyway.
London is surrounded and we have sent a surrender offer to the British.
OUR BLITZKRIEG HAS NO RIVAL!
Mozajsk - Mozhaisk (ZS#01), 01/06/1942
Comrade! Your task is to prevent Germans from stopping our offensive at the temporary positions at Mozhaisk.
General, the fighting has been hard but London is ours!!! Churchill has escaped to the North, now no one can deny the Third Reich's Victory!!!
Amazing job, Commander.  We dropped you into a real mess, but you came out smelling like a rose.  The fighting was tough, but your boys hung in there.
In this case, your defeat was due to the inaptitude of the Italian forces.
General, although you overran Hitler's headquarters, the Fuhrer managed to escape by U-Boat to South America. The world still lives in fear of the Nazi menace.
Finally, we have conquered the Rock, the British showed us a hard resistance by using the hard conditions of the Gibraltar soil. Now the Mediterranean is closed, and the South bank, secured.
Congratulations, the great British empire is in ruins, the battles were hard but we are victorious.
Now, the British will have to choice between surrender and die. The Italians in Lybia launch an attack.
Badly, you will have some short vacations because the Führer Himself had ordered you to report in Berlin.
No one knows what he is preparing for the glory of Third Reich!
Well, I don't think that all is over, the Italians have launched an attack from Lybia.
Our task here is over, report in Berlin at once.

Congratulations!, all the British Army units have been erased from the map on this area. Now, we can start the refurbishment of the port in order to install here our Field Head Quarters, and start to receiving reinforcements from the Continental soil. Good work.
General here we stand on the banks of the Volga.
We have to get across quickly to keep our advance moving before
those Soviet forces from Poland get here.
We may have helped them reopen the front there, but I have no
intention to let them get all the credit.

Good work!, we have captured the port of Lyme Regis according to the plan. Now, we should start the refurbishment of the docks in order to allow the arrival of more reinforcements. We will install here our Fields H.Q.
The worst has happened, the British have cut off our supply lines with the port, and we are isolated here!. If we can escape from here, a Military council would be waiting for you in Berlin!!.
We have secured the city of Taunton, and now the way to Bristol is clear. We expect the improvement of your actions, otherwise we will be forced to remove you from the command.
Commander, you did a good job. However, our forces are losing ground everywhere. You must withdraw you men to Dunkirk to be evacuated.
Wonderful!, with this victory here all the South East of England is under our control!, now the British can not receive supplies from the United States and its allies!, good work Herr General!.
The British have stopped us here!, run out from my sight before I shot you with my Walter P-38!!.
Your failure is beyond comprehension.  The enemy armies have already have begun to counterattack.  You are now reassigned to duty as commander of our garrison in the Falkland Islands.

I'm really impressed by your skills!, the defensive lines established by the British here have been completely overrun and all the goals have been captured, also, the supply lines with the South have been secured... and now we can drive to London!.

You are stupid!, you have destroyed all the operation with your poor actions!, now it's supposed that we surely would start the evacuation of all the beach-heads before the British could make a counter-attack. A Military Council is already waiting for you in Germany!.
We have got the victory!, now London is completely besieged by our forces, and the last British defenders are enclosed into the capital, they have two options; surrender, or die!
The British have stopped us here!, run out from my sight before I shoot you with my Walter P-38!!.
Superb work, Commander!  The Italians have been driven from our colony.  Our forces are now pursuing the enemy deep into Abyssynia.  Soon Italy will be out of East Africa entirely.
Superb work, Commander! The Italians have been driven from our colony.  Our forces are now pursuing the enemy deep into Abyssynia.  Soon Italy will be out of East Africa entirely.
Well, nice work.  Now, we've got men and machines rolling into southern Italy, and rumor has it that Italy's on the verge of surrendering.  Good goin', Commander.
I would have liked for more time, but this will have to do
The engineers have got part of the defenses in place, I hope its enough

You are stupid!, you have destroyed all the operation with your poor performance!, now it is supposed that we surely would start the evacuation of all the beach-heads before the British could make a counter-attack. A Military Council is already waiting for you in Germany!
General, that was horrible
Thank god we could divert some Marines to finish your job.
I don't like owing the Navy a favor so don't do that again.
Very Good General! now is the moment to regroup our units with the reinforcements coming from France.
Good! the capture of Brighton took much time than expected, but we did it!
Thanks to this victory, the 9th army under your command and the 16th army can help each other. The 16th will move to the north while we will move to the West.
The British have stopped us here!, run out from my sight before I shoot you with my Walter P-38!!!
I had hoped you would have performed better General.
Ivan has had just as much success in the North.
The whole front is in general retreat.
We better stop him soon
This is a choice scenario. The campaign consists in three different paths and you can select which path you will follow.
If you get a BRILLAND VICTORY: you will command the 16th army with six divisions embarked in Calais Boulogne-sur-Mer to disembark in the zone of Dover-Margate.
This will be the zone of most battles because you have to keep a line open in the channel to allow reinforcements and transports.

If you get VICTORY: You will be assigned to the 9th army with four divisions embarked in Le Havre to disembark between Brighton and Isle of Wight. Your duty will be give support to the 16th army to surround London later.

If you get TACTICAL VICTORY: you will be in charge of 6th army with three divisions embarked in Cherbourg to disembark in Lyme Regis, your orders are to distract the attention of the enemy moving out to Bristol to then turn to London.

Operation Sealion:
Herr General, the time has come to invade the British islands, your troops embark on Calais, along with other three division embarked on Boulogne-sur-Mer, both have to confront the enemy.

You already know that due to the impossibility of transport heavy units, we haven't any land transport, tanks or heavy artillery. Your mission will be the capture the port of Dover and then Margate and Ramsgate.
Paratrooper groups are behind the enemy lines, their mission is capture and airstrip of crusial matter, advanced carefully through the channel to clean the mines. Good luck!
2nd Luft..Abt.
3 Luft.Abt.
Canterbury:
General, we've paid a high price, but we are close to finish the fist stage of our operations.
Your objective is the City of Canterbury and the airstrip of Lympne, crucial communication center of the enemy. The resistance you will find will probably be the rest of 10th and 12th infantry.
Playing tip: Move also reinforcement units from PORT hexes ("Calais") to PORT hexes ("Dover") via the "strategic transport" button (see lower left button of any unit when right-clicking on it).
Gillingham:

General, I hope you've got enough transports for this operation because the distances are long and we're lacking of time. Your objectives are the cities of Sittingbourne, Sheerness and Gillingham, the capture of Maidstone will be the duty of the 8th panzer division that comes from the south.

Don't waste your time with the forces on Sheppey's Island because the aren't important at all and would only delay you. Paratrooper groups are already in the landzone to clean the path to advance more quickly.
Gravesend - Dover Path:
General, we continue with our unstoppable advance in the inner island. Your objectives is the city of Gravesend, it is the key to take Tilbury and Grays, which would allow us to advance to the north.
You will be supported by the 4th panzer division and the 20th motorized division that coming from the south which has the objectives to capture the cities of Dartford and Bexteyhead, outside London.
Again, paratrooper groups will be assist you eliminating defensive posts and delay the enemy counterattacks.
Maldon:
The Plan was better than expected. Now we have to finish the second stage of Seelöwe.
Take three divisions and move to conquer the city of Maldon, meanwhile another three units are moving to Watfort to close the paths to London from the North.
Assign two or three units to take Brentwood, I don't think that more forces will be necessary.
The engineers haven't got very much done.
Counterattack:

General, we have underestimated the opponent, not only the British has been denied our surrender offer but they have sent their best troops against us from London lauching a counterattack to Gravesend.
The situation is critical, if they are successful they will split our main forces in the North, on the cities of Maldon and Watfort, preventing our forces to resupply.
Your mission is to advance as fast as you can to avoid the lost of Gravesend and restore the front.
Beware, the Brits have reactivated small well trained resistance groups in the forests and towns nearby.
They can irreversibly delay your advance.
The success of this operation is in your hands!\x00

Well, the promised hour has come, thirteen division surround London. Since the Roman Empire times, no one has ever reached this point, the direct order to attack London is out, and you are the one in charge.

Most of the London's defenses are out because they died in the Gravesend counterattack, but remember that a big city can eat huge armies like a wolf. Bring down the enemy's morale taking his most representative symbols, each second counts! You are dismissed!!! GO!!!
Malta:

General, due to your unique successes in amphibious assault operations, our Italians allies have requested our help in the capture of the Malta Island. Have in mind that RAF is weakened, but even under those circumstances, it can overpass the Italians in experience.
Plan G: Assault on Gibraltar.

After the British surrender, the OKH have selected you to defeat the remaining British troops which have not surrendered yet. While the Japanese will make the same in the Indian Ocean, we are going to destroy the British forces in the Mediterranean, starting with Gibraltar. General Franco finally have allowed us to cross Spain with three divisions wich are supported by a Spanish Infantry division, and by some Spanish navy and Kriegsmarine units. With those forces at your disposal you should take the Rock. The LuftWaffe will arrive to help you, as well as our special commandos 'Brandenburgers', in sea men suits. Good Luck!

Suez:

General, the British are almost defeated, the Japanese have taken all the British belongings in Asia along with its Mediterran strongpoints. London is under our control, the remaining Royal Navy pieces are scattered everywhere, and they won't be nomore any threat to us.
However, they have one more important strongpoint: Suez.
Our Italian allies (don't make any joke, we both know that they are very poor) with a tremendous effort have passed through the channel taking some casualities.

But now you are here, you will be the one in charge, we know that this is the last fight where the Royal Army still has some power, so beware, and be quick like a bolt of lighting. If you take much time it would probably mean that the British would have destroyed the installations to avoid their capture.
Lyme Regis:

After departure from Cherbourg in the past hours, we have reached this nearby point to Plymouth, the little port of Lyme Regis, where you should make the third beach-head, and start to advance following the plan. Two LuftWaffe's Squadrons are above us, and they will show the British what the LuftWaffe is capable of with valuable support, as well as some little Kriegsmarine support ships, wich will destroy the sea mines deployed in all the Lyme Bay by the British. In the other hand, you could test our new amphibious Panzers!, we have just dropped them into the water, and now they are rumbling under the sea!. Be aware, in spite of the defense of Lyme consist of Home Guard militias only, it's possible they will receive some reinforcements from the North.

Taunton:

We have just established our HQ on Lyme, your next mission after seizing the port, is to make the roads safe we will use to drive our attack on Bristol. We need to capture the city of Taunton, intelligence reports that the British could be preparing a counter-attack from the other side of the river which crosses Taunton; we must avoid this, if the British destroy our communications with the port, our units in Bristol would be completely isolated. We expect the best from you, General.
Bristol:

Herr General, we have arrived to our first important goal in our part of the operation; the assault on Bristol. The British are trying to make a defensive line here, using Bristol as an important reference point. Surely, we will face a harder resistance here than in the first days of the invasion. Fortunately, huge LuftWaffe formations will support us in order to suppress these heavy resistance into the streets of Bristol, as well as the 7th FJ Division of General Student, which is coming from the sea to take the British by surprise from their back. Intelligence reports that maybe the British Home Guard are hiding supplies into the nearly forests with the aim to make some skirmishes on our supply lines while we attack Bristol, so be aware about this. Good Luck.
